note: SKUdesk keeper bots on Robinhood Chain Testnet: scripted bots, not people. The addresses are public. Each one was matched to its keeper role from public on-chain behaviour only (side, order sizes, participation), compared with the open strategy code in apps/web/tools/market-common.ts (plansFor). No private key or .env was read. A role is the script's pricing rule against its own reference price for the market (not a market feed); every order that fills trades at the epoch's one clearing price.
